purpose: Four genuinely new evaluation visits for two frozen forests. No training, policy fitting or automatic activation.

network_context.limits: Reachability verified, hotspot identity user-declared. No campus/new-network generalization.

browser_session_policy: Chrome entirely closed at preparation; reopen normal Chrome after intent, start stripped NetLog, start capture, navigate target. Stop app/log; keep Chrome open until archive verifies lifetimes.
collection: Edge app, Wi-Fi9, reference checking ON, longer windows OFF. Normal Chrome, Strip private information NetLog, sensitive/raw bytes OFF. Deliberate Start only, 120s capture cap; target activity60s. No candidate results during collection.
eligibility: Existing browser-reference mapping, socket/packet QC and unchanged measured prefix values; all eligible supported rows retained. No prediction-based exclusions. One complete target IPv6 flow minimum per visit; no arbitrary three-flow yield requirement.
primary: 10 packets, target-service flows only: average recall equally over the two visits of each service, then equally over services. Compare both frozen forests on identical prefixes. Incidental local-service flows and other budgets are secondary, all retained.
scoring: Only after all four usable archives, no interim candidate scores. One write-once paired ranking report. This descriptive screen cannot calibrate confidence or promote the model.
attempts: Exactly four slots, two dates, fresh Chrome process per slot; no extra replacement visits. Genuine QC/support failure stops scope. Processor errors preserve same attempt for repair. Day1 YT then IG, day2 IG then YT. Prior training slots remain paused and none count toward evaluation.
limits: Small prospective two-service hotspot evaluation, correlated flows/prefixes, only two visits per service. No population reliability, family causality, probability calibration, significance or campus transfer claim. Training and all earlier local outcome datasets excluded. Failed screen ends this scope; no automatic retraining, gate changes, extra seeds or recordings.

trials.activity: Watch a different YouTube video for60s in newly started normal Chrome.
Scroll feed30s, then watch different Reels30s in newly started normal Chrome.
On a later local date, scroll feed30s, then watch different Reels30s in newly started normal Chrome.
On that same later date, watch a different video60s in newly started normal Chrome.
